title: Unofficial Homeowners: Back Home in Virginia Beach
description: Returning to the family brick ranch off Military Highway in Kempsville after walking out of Fishersville, twenty-one-year-old twins Katie and Nate Prairie set up house together as unofficial homeowners—turning Nate's old room into their dual-desk software office, putting a queen bed in Katie's room while outfitting the bedroom closet with a sleeping bag and pillows that all three of them know the twins will sleep in almost every night, and mastering server-side PHP and SQL from home.
